question: Four entries of awesome-tunneling have no egress record: ngrok 1.0 (github.com/inconshreveable/ngrok, legacy open-source tunnel), Ngrok-operator (github.com/zufardhiyaulhaq/ngrok-operator, a Kubernetes operator for ngrok), Pomerium (pomerium.com, an identity-aware access proxy) and Tailcat (tailscale.com/tailcat). Which of them is a tunnel, UDP forward, WireGuard ingress, IPv6 broker, overlay or NAT host, and what do their first-party pages state as byte cap, ports and protocols, identity and first paid price?
why: The list holds 156 product entries; 152 have a record and these 4 have none (README capture of 2026-11-03). None is in the slice entries 66 to 75 of the open-source section, so it was left to a unit with that scope. Ngrok 1.0 and Ngrok-operator are software the user installs and runs, so they rank last.
